title: SPANISH LANGUAGE – LEVEL 03
overview: This pre-intermediate Spanish course builds on Levels 01 and 02 to strengthen independent communication in familiar social, travel and workplace situations. Participants extend their control of past and future narration, develop more flexible sentence patterns, and practise sustained listening, speaking, reading and writing through realistic tasks. The programme emphasises intelligibility, confidence and appropriate language use rather than memorisation alone.
audience: Learners who have completed Spanish Language – Level 02 or possess equivalent elementary Spanish knowledge and wish to progress toward confident pre-intermediate communication for personal, travel or professional purposes.
methodology: Interactive trainer-led instruction; guided grammar discovery; pair and group conversations; role-plays; authentic short audio and reading materials; pronunciation coaching; scenario-based writing; regular formative feedback; and integrated skills assessments.
competencies: Sustain connected conversations about routine experiences, preferences, plans and familiar problems.
Narrate past events and describe ongoing or habitual actions using appropriate verb forms.
Understand the main ideas and relevant details in clear spoken and written Spanish.
Produce coherent messages, short reports and practical correspondence with improving accuracy.
Adapt language to common social, travel, service and workplace contexts.
objectives: Distinguish and apply key past tenses when recounting experiences and events.
Express intentions, predictions, obligations, recommendations and polite requests.
Use pronouns, connectors and more complex sentence structures to communicate efficiently.
Participate in discussions, explanations and problem-solving exchanges on familiar topics.
Interpret short authentic texts and audio recordings and respond appropriately.
Write connected paragraphs, emails and descriptions with suitable register and organisation.

outline.title: Reading for Main Ideas and Detail

items.text: Read short articles, notices, emails and informational texts.
Identify purpose, key facts, opinions and supporting details.
Infer unfamiliar vocabulary from context.
Understand clear conversations and short recordings on familiar subjects.
Practise rhythm, word stress, linking and challenging sound contrasts.
Use clarification and confirmation strategies when listening breaks down.
Complete realistic social, travel and workplace communication scenarios.
Deliver a short spoken account and write a connected practical text.
Receive individual feedback and recommendations for Level 04 progression.
